tasks.label: Run & Install to Phone (DevDebug)
tasks.command: .\gradlew.bat installDevDebug ; $dev = (adb devices | Where-Object { $_ -match '	device$' } | Select-Object -First 1).Split("`t")[0]; if ($dev) { adb -s $dev shell am start -n com.dev.bitchord/com.music.bitchord.MainActivity } else { adb shell am start -n com.dev.bitchord/com.music.bitchord.MainActivity }
